reason: Fruiting body of a lichen (examples: Hypotrachyna, Peltigera, Collema), which is a fungal structure. It is outside the scope of PO and FLOPO, which cover plants, so it should not be grounded or proposed to PO.
Exact in use. These are the scales of conifer seed cones (Abies, Larix, Pinus, with apophyses). PO lists cone scale and ovuliferous scale as synonyms of megasporophyll.

target: native plant cell (PO_0025606), part of non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075) through pattern 12 or a fixed part_of; wall qualities are read on the cell (thick walls = thick-walled cells)
reason: Moss leaf (lamina) cells. PO has no cell-wall class, and a GO cellular component would be the only exact bearer. Wall thickness, pitting, nodosity and sinuosity are standard descriptors of the cells. If moss floras are run in full, consider a FLOPO class 'non-vascular leaf lamina cell' (is_a PO_0025606, part_of PO_0025075) to collect all the 'laminal cell' names.

Narrower. 220 of the 222 statements are North American Flora grass descriptions (Anastrophus = Axonopus), where 'fruiting scale' is the hardened lemma of the fertile floret. The two Betula statements mean a fruiting catkin bract (inflorescence bract PO_0009054), so the rule should be limited to Poaceae.

Narrower: the hooded upper lip of a two-lipped corolla (Pedicularis-type: crested, curving into a beak). 'Upper' can be added as a position (pattern 04). In Aconitum and in orchids a galea is a hooded sepal or sepals, so limit the rule to Orobanchaceae, Lamiaceae and Scrophulariaceae.
Exact for 'spike' (Carex). 'Pistillate' is read as the quality female (PATO:0000383) under the earlier rule C232, not as part of the bearer.
French preposition ('for') in phrases that split a total ('dont 2–3 pour l'acumen', '3 pour l'andropodium'). It is a fragment; the real part is the noun after it.

label: pinna rachis
definition: A stalk (PO:0025066) that is the axis of a pinna of a bipinnate or more highly compound leaf, bearing the pinnules or pinna segments.
reason: Bipinnate leaves (Acacia, many legumes; also Leea and ferns). PO leaf rachis (PO_0020055) is defined as the main axis only, so it cannot be used. Propose to PO together with pinna and pinnule.

target: native plant cell (PO_0025606), part of leaf base (PO_0020040) of a non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075); position 'marginal' through pattern 04
reason: Moss leaf cells near the margin at the leaf base. This is not alar cell (PO_0030057), which is restricted to the basal angles. See the note under 'laminal cell wall' about a shared lamina-cell class.

target: phyllome lamina lobe (PO_0025514), part of pinnule (FLOPO_0985028)
reason: Fern pinnule segments are lobes of a pinnatifid pinnule, counted in pairs. This is a part of an existing class; 'basal', 'lower' and so on go through pattern 04.

French 'calicule' = calyculus, which PO lists as an EXACT synonym of epicalyx. Exact for Hibiscus and the Malvaceae. In Asteraceae (Emilia, Crassocephalum) the calyculus is outer bracts at the base of the involucre, so involucral bract (PO_0009045) there; for Cephalaria use involucel (FLOPO_0986039). Apply it as a family-dependent rule. Note: FLOPO_0986037 epicalyx says PO has no epicalyx, but PO_0009063 exists, so check for a duplicate.

label: hyaline cell
parent: is_a PO_0025606 (native plant cell); part_of PO_0025075 (non-vascular leaf)
definition: A native plant cell (PO:0025606) of the leaf of Sphagnum that is large, dead and empty at maturity, often strengthened by fibrils and perforated by pores, and that holds water. Hyaline cells alternate with narrow living chlorophyllose cells in a network.
reason: A distinct cell type used in every Sphagnum description (rhombic, fibrillose, pores counted). PO has other bryophyte cell types (alar cell, hydroid) but not this one. Propose to PO (Bryophytes subset).

The narrowed stalk-like base of the legume standard. 'Claw' was rejected only because it lacked its organ, and here the organ is given. A general 'petal claw' class (is_a PO_0025066, part_of PO_0009032) would serve many families and is worth considering.

target: filament (PO_0009067), its distal region (plant organ apex FLOPO_0985023 part of filament)
reason: In Asteraceae (Senecioneae: Crassocephalum, Emilia, Cissampelopsis, Synotis) the antheropodium is the filament collar: the thickened top of the filament just below the anther. It is a region of the filament, not a separate organ.

label: spine shield
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009047 (stem)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a hard, horny pad on the angle of the stem of a succulent Euphorbia, bearing the spines of a node, and that may be separate or run together with neighbouring pads into a continuous horny margin.
reason: Standard character in the Kew African floras for spiny Euphorbia (Flora of Tropical East Africa, Flora Zambesiaca; 107 statements, about 70 taxa). PO has no class. Could be proposed to PO, though only for one genus group.

Narrower: the separate scale-like segments of a divided floral disc (Wikstroemia, Cleistanthus, Cansjera), counted as parts of the disc. They are not necessarily glandular, so not disc gland (FLOPO_0986045).

target: phyllome lamina lobe (PO_0025514), part of pinna (FLOPO_0985027)
reason: Lobes of a pinnatifid fern pinna, counted in pairs. A part of an existing class, handled the same way as pinnule segment.

label: limbidium
parent: is_a PO_0020128 (leaf margin); part_of PO_0025075 (non-vascular leaf)
definition: A leaf margin (PO:0020128) of a non-vascular leaf that is a border of elongate, often thick-walled cells that differ clearly from the cells of the lamina.
reason: Moss leaf border (Fissidens and others). Mapping it to plain leaf margin would make 'limbidium absent' read as 'margin absent', so a subclass is needed. Propose to PO (Bryophytes subset).
A 'per X' phrase giving the container of a count ('blades 3–6 per fertile culm'). Not a structure; the container is stem (PO_0009047) and 'fertile' is its state.
Exact in use: in Habenaria and Centrostigma the lip (labellum) is divided into 3 segments (the 'median', the lateral ones, filiform).

target: native plant cell (PO_0025606), part of leaf base (PO_0020040) of a non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075), next to the costa (PO_0030072)
reason: Moss leaf cells at the base, next to the costa (midrib). A position on existing classes, handled like basal marginal laminal cell.

label: infrastaminal scale
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of FLOPO_0985018 (corolla tube)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is a thin, often fringed scale-like appendage on the inner face of the corolla tube, below the insertion of a stamen.
reason: Key character in every Cuscuta description (FNA, other floras; 84 statements). It sits inside the tube below the stamens, not at the throat, so it is not corolline corona (FLOPO_0985021). Keep it local to FLOPO; low priority for PO.

target: leaf margin (PO_0020128), part of leaf sheath (PO_0020104) of a culm leaf (pattern 12 / fixed part_of)
reason: Bamboo culm sheaths are the sheaths of culm leaves; their margins are ciliate or setose. This is a region of an existing class.
A broken lemmatization of 'spore radius', used as a unit in a ratio ('proximal laesura less than 0.4 spore radius'). It is a measure, not a structure.

target: phyllome lamina lobe (PO_0025514), part of pinna (FLOPO_0985027)
reason: Segments of a pinnatifid or pinnatisect fern pinna, counted in pairs and joined by a narrow wing. 'Basal pinna segments auriculate' uses pattern 04.
Narrower: lobes of the epichile, the distal part of the orchid labellum (FLOPO_0986029). Each is a division of the labellum.
A 'per X' phrase giving the container of a count ('stems 1 per caudex branch'). The container is stem (PO_0009047, caudex synonym).

label: prostome
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0025094 (sporangium)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a moss capsule that is a rudimentary, often fragmentary membrane or ring of tissue outside the exostome of the peristome (PO:0030042).
reason: Orthotrichum character. It can be absent while the peristome is present, so peristome (PO_0030042) cannot be used. Used only in Orthotrichaceae, so low priority for PO; if FLOPO wants no genus-group classes, reject instead.

label: loment segment
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0030101 (loment fruit)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is one of the one-seeded segments into which a loment fruit (PO:0030101) is divided by constrictions and at which it breaks apart.
reason: Counted and described in many legume genera (Aeschynomene, Humularia, Desmodium, Alysicarpus). Plain 'article' was rejected for lacking its organ; here the organ is clear. Propose to PO next to loment fruit.

target: inflorescence axis internode (PO_0006326), part of spikelet rachilla (PO_0009080)
reason: The segments of the grass spikelet rachilla between florets. These are internodes of an existing axis class.
